causality_limits: The automatic-review rejection explains why attempt 06 lacks a completed qualification result; it does not prove the cause of the earlier Spark startup wait.
MLflow telemetry is not established as the cause of the Java gateway loss in attempt 04 or the broker/client timing gaps and create_topics timeout in attempt 05.
Out-of-memory, CPU throttling, orphan JVM accumulation and other resource explanations remain unproven.
Attempt 07 was reported as in progress when this evidence bundle was prepared. This receipt does not assert its outcome.
